bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
pg=deploy-postgres-1
test "$(docker inspect "$pg" --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 61
sql="SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN 'PAID_ONLY_FOUND' ELSE 'PAID_ONLY_MISSING' END,coalesce(max(r.paid_message_id),0),coalesce(max(l.price_stars),0),coalesce(max(r.status),'missing'),coalesce(max(l.status),'missing'),coalesce(max((l.seller_user_id=788044853)::int),-1),coalesce((SELECT count(*) FROM videobot_stars_ledger t WHERE t.delivery_key='singlepaid4714_20261123:1' AND t.kind='paid'),0) FROM videobot_post_receipts r JOIN videobot_listings l ON l.listing_id=r.listing_id WHERE r.listing_id='singlepaid4714_20261123';"
docker exec -e "SQL=$sql" "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d videobot -At -F "|" -c "$SQL"'
